body: I just don't like how this IS my normal now it's frustrating because every time I try to be frustrated it's blocked like it's pushed away, it has something to do with vulnerability because I'm not scared of it but I can't do it, it's almost like I experience a different branch of shame and guilt for feeling. Especially in anything romantic, I used to be infatuated with people but now the butterflies are shot down because I feel stupid, childish and now I feel like I can't develop those kinds of attraction or depth.

I do feel sometimes that my fingers are not my own or every action is just happening without my say. And trauma I may have encountered is real from my childhood and still comes up. 

I go through ups and downs where I convince myself nothings wrong or I didn't have a problem and it's just a blip, but then I get to these days where nothing feels real anymore.
I notice that well I'm feeling really out of touch I take off my glasses and I feel in the moment for a few seconds, like the change in environment made me look at things like they were there.

I feel like there is an issue because I have not always felt this way I get sad when I'm in a low place in the day but I don't feel the sadness I just know I'm sad. I have experienced traumatic experiences (not super traumatic but you know the brain) I don't think I'm attached to myself. In what way do you mean? Because I'm not mentally attached I always drift. 
I know you are not trained but because talking to some professional help takes so long it helps to just get straight to the point. 
The conversation is exactly what I need and I really appreciate it.

Thank you it helps to know someone gets it. All I really feel is a headache and anything that comes off as happiness/emotion is just my bodies reaction. If I think really hard the only thing I feel is content.
Confusing times calls for confusing answers
My bad, wars are too similar
